findings.where: §12.5 step 3, §9.13 step 2, §9.8 unbundle (hardened G flags from §9.11), §23 item 19
findings.title: Every bundle fetch runs under protocol.file.allow=never, which git refuses for bundles (verified git 2.55: 'transport file not allowed'); the override is scoped to bundle verify, which does not need it. Every /package, import validation and unbundle fails closed, so no contribution can complete
findings.fix: Scope -c protocol.file.allow=always (last -c wins) to the bundle fetch argv only, in the gatekeeper (12.5 step 3, 9.13 step 2) and in unbundle.sh (both modes); keep never everywhere else; list-heads/verify keep plain GIT_ARGS; reword 12.5 step 3; add the fact to §23 item 19; run test_real_package_script_bundle/test_package_verify with production GIT_ARGS and add test_unbundle_script_real_bundle

findings.where: §15.2 Hermes-side probe (launch_spec()/session_new_params() reuse), §15.2 vendoring path ~hermes/.hermes/plugins/model-providers/kiro-acp, §7.5, §18.1 ctl/hermes_probe.py, ADR-0002
findings.title: Root ossbot-hermes-probe reuses the vendored adapter's code 'so the probe and production cannot drift', but its import origin is unspecified and the production copy is hermes-writable; importing it as root is a hermes->root escalation that breaks the write-token and kill-switch boundaries
findings.fix: Root imports kiro_acp only from a root-owned /opt/ossbot/vendor/hermes-kiro-provider copy, never from or via sys.path under /home/hermes; root hashes the deployed ~hermes copy (regular files, O_NOFOLLOW) and fails the probe with adapter_drift on mismatch; add adapter_sha256 to the probe key; hermes-owned executables run only via runuser -u hermes; test that kiro_acp origin is under /opt/ossbot and that a modified hermes copy -> adapter_drift

findings.title: Unbundle list-heads check is stated as exactly refs/heads/ossbot-change for all modes, but import bundles carry import_head_ref
findings.fix: fix_round: single head == refs/heads/ossbot-change; import: single head == contributions.import_head_ref passed as bundle_ref from gatekeeper state

findings.title: Checkpoint checks only running; a /dryrun on landing mid-submission does not stop the next live write
findings.fix: control_checkpoint() also requires control_state.dry_run == snapshot.dry_run; mismatch -> interrupted -> SUBMIT_FAILED with 'mode changed during submission'

findings.title: Runner catalog upsert has no endpoint in the closed §12.2 API list
findings.fix: Add POST /v1/models/catalog (worker) {models:[{model_id,name}]}, ids validated with the --force regex, ≤ 200 entries, never sets forced

findings.title: Root clones and chowns inside hermes-writable /home/hermes/.hermes ($D.new symlink pre-plant on upgrade); mv -T onto an existing $D fails and the .prev step is not shown
findings.fix: Clone/verify in root-owned /var/lib/ossbot/staging/hermes-<tag>, chown -R --no-dereference, refuse if any target is a symlink, mv -T $D $D.prev then mv -T staging $D

findings.where: §10.8 create spec Cmd and Env rows
findings.title: Filter does not bind Cmd to profile, so profile=catalog + kiro.sh + KIRO_API_KEY passes the backstop layer
findings.fix: Bind Cmd per profile (catalog=>list_models; research/agent-llm=>kiro; agent-exec=>exec; snapshot=>snapshot; probe=>probe) and add a deny-corpus case

findings.title: Numstat invocations are not pinned like FORMAT_PATCH (diff.renames etc.), so the numstat-set comparison depends on built-in defaults
findings.fix: Define ossbot.common.gitcmd.NUMSTAT with -c diff.algorithm=myers -c diff.renames=false -c core.quotePath=true and use it on both sides
